newsitem.title: ROMANIA: GYMNASTICS-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION IN "CRITICAL" CONDITION.
newsitem.headline: GYMNASTICS-FORMER WORLD CHAMPION IN "CRITICAL" CONDITION.

text.p: Ex-gymnastics world champion Dan Grecu has been taken to hospital in a "critical" condition, a Romanian Health Ministry spokesman said on Monday.
Grecu, now Romania's team trainer, is suffering from food poisoning after eating some canned vegetables.
Grecu, 47, was rings world champion in 1974. He also won the European championship in 1975 and took bronze at the 1976 Olympics.
